title: Exhaustive audit of a large artifact set, partitioned, with a coverage ledger and a sampled second reader
goal: Audit every unit in the input inventory against the audit question, with each finding tied to its unit and location, and prove that every unit was read.

assumptions: The caller supplies a complete inventory (one entry per unit: id, path, bytes) produced by code, not by a model
Units are independent enough to audit one shard at a time; cross-unit issues are found in the reconcile step
risks: A shard silently skipped or skimmed
The same issue reported twice across shards
The reader misses issues a second reader would catch
successCriteria: Every inventory unit appears in exactly one shard and is reported as read
Every finding names its unit and location
A different-model second reader on a sample of shards agrees within the stated miss rate
unsupported: Units larger than one reader's input budget (split them first)
Inventories whose shard plan exceeds the 512 KB code-output cap (about 10,000 units): pass references to the inventory, not the inventory

nodes.description: Pack the inventory into shards under a byte budget, keeping each directory together where it fits; code owns the coverage plan
Audit each shard; each reader must list every unit it read and tie every finding to a unit and location
Read every unit in this shard and answer the audit question for it
nodes.instructions: Audit each unit listed in the shard against the question. Return every unit id you read in `read`, and every finding with its unit id, a location (line or byte range) and a one-sentence reason. Report an empty findings list for a clean unit; never skip a unit.

nodes.description: Code checks that the reader read exactly the shard's units and that every finding names a unit of this shard
Merge the shards' findings, de-duplicated on unit + location + reason, and list failed shards by id (coverage is proved by the ledger verifier, not here)
The engine's coverage ledger: every inventory unit was read by exactly one shard reader, no reader named a unit outside the inventory, and no shard failed
Choose the shards for the second reader by a fixed rule (every k-th shard), so the sample is not chosen by a model
A different model re-audits the sampled shards blind to the first reader's findings
Independent second reading of one sampled shard
nodes.instructions: Audit each unit listed in the shard against the question. Return every unit id you read and every finding with unit, location and reason.

model.justification: The second reader must be a different, stronger model than the first so that their misses are less correlated; this is the one place a larger class is spent.

nodes.description: Code estimates the first reader's miss rate on the sample: findings the second reader made that the first did not, per unit
